entries.name: Goblet Squat
entries.coachingIntent: Use a front-held load to practise an upright, balanced squat before heavier loading.
entries.instructions: Hold one dumbbell or kettlebell close to the chest with the forearms supporting it. Stand around shoulder width with the toes turned to a comfortable angle and pressure across the whole foot. Sit between the hips and stand tall; if the load pulls the chest down, use a lighter weight or a shorter depth.

entries.name: Band Good Morning
entries.coachingIntent: Use forgiving band tension to rehearse a clean hip hinge before heavier loading.
